name: @ipfs-datasets/logic-runtime-mtl
description: Independent RuntimeMTLMonitor@1 finite-trace MTL/LTLf TypeScript/Node monitor

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const p='dist/src/cli.js'; const t=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); if(!t.startsWith('#!')) fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+t); fs.chmodSync(p,0o755);"
